# Dr. Lal PathLabs Patient Service Centre - Khargapur, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow

> Authorized Patient Service Centre (franchise) of Dr. Lal PathLabs in Khargapur, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. This website is the local centre website, not the official corporate website of Dr. Lal PathLabs Ltd.

This site provides information for local patients about blood tests, diagnostic services, health checkup packages, booking and home sample collection in Lucknow. Prices and availability can change; patients should confirm current details before booking or visiting.

## Centre

- [Home](https://www.bloodtestinlucknow.com/): Main website and centre information
- [Contact](https://www.bloodtestinlucknow.com/contact): Contact details, hours and booking assistance
- [About](https://www.bloodtestinlucknow.com/about): Centre and service information
- [Home collection](https://www.bloodtestinlucknow.com/home-collection): Home sample collection information
- [Book a test](https://www.bloodtestinlucknow.com/book-test): Test booking

## Tests and packages

- [All tests](https://www.bloodtestinlucknow.com/tests): Blood tests and diagnostic tests
- [Health packages](https://www.bloodtestinlucknow.com/health-packages): Health checkup packages
